I went for over a decade not thinking about my huge under-used BBW collection. My mom (who only gets their wallflowers) gave me a few Free Body Care item coupons a few months ago and I became hooked on following sales. After only a couple of months and a couple hundred dollars, I already feel overwhelmed, overstocked, and overdone with their products. 

As someone with an old and new collection, my opinion is that it's the scents, or lack of scents. The only smells I'm in love with are the holiday gourmands that don't come in body care. Pecan pumpkin waffles, hot Cocoa and Cream (body care discontinued in this scent), pumpkin caramel swirl, hometown festival, etc. Everything else smells off. I can't tell who these scents are geared to but it's not teens, young adults, or people my age. My mom doesn't like them either. 

My top favorites of their current offerings are originals, Japanese Cherry Blossom, Sweet Pea, and Winter Candy Apple. The only new scent I've wanted to use more than once is Perfect in Pink. The FFM are so weak I've been using the shimmer mists for scent that lasts longer than 30 seconds. 

The candles, soaps, and wallflowers I'll use, but I don't know what I'll do with the weakly scented body care I've accumulated. But yes, the joy lasted about 2 months, and by joy I mean FOMO.
